context: A teacher discusses an East Asian history class
purpose: Teach: 竹島/南京/テポドン/フセイン/正日/日の丸/猪瀬/姉歯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近現代史、竹島問題、南京事件、両方扱う章、難しいですね。
lines.en: Modern history—Takeshima, Nanjing—those chapters are genuinely difficult to teach, aren't they.
lines.style: Measured opening, acknowledging complexity. Slight pause at the dashes. Gentle cadence inviting shared understanding, not lecturing. Warm recognition of difficulty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。北朝鮮のテポドン発射、金正日体制下の出来事として、年表に入っています。
lines.en: Yes. North Korea's Taepodong missile launch under Kim Jong-il is listed on the timeline.
lines.style: Steady, factual tone. Precise articulation of the technical name. No embellishment—just presenting what's in the material. Engaged but not performing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: イラクのフセイン政権、当時の国際情勢の中で考察します。
lines.en: Iraq's Hussein regime—we examine it through the international context of the period.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight emphasis on 'international context' showing pedagogical intent. Poised but not distant. The voice of someone who has thought through how to frame this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国内では、日の丸の議論、教育現場で長く続いてきました。
lines.en: And domestically, the debates over the flag have been ongoing in schools for a long time.
lines.style: Quieter, more observational. Builds gently toward the statement. Slight weight on 'long time'—acknowledging the persistence. Inviting reflection rather than conclusion.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の都知事猪瀬氏の発言、参考資料に入れています。
lines.en: That's why we've included then-Governor Inose's remarks as reference material.
lines.style: Grounding statement. Clear connection between observation and practical choice. Even pace, slight nod of justification without defensiveness. Teaching decision made transparent.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 姉歯事件のような建築偽装の章も、同時期の社会不安として扱われていますね。
lines.en: So the Anehae scandal—architectural fraud like that—shows up as social instability of the same era.
lines.style: Connecting threads with slight enthusiasm. 'So' draws the line. Quickens slightly on 'same era' as the pattern clicks into place. Curious and clarifying, not interrogative.
